long_biography.plain_text:
Bin Sulayem's career developed through Dubai's trade institutions rather than a privately founded enterprise. Appointed to lead the Jebel Ali Free Zone in the 1980s, he oversaw its expansion. He later chaired Dubai World, where his remit included property developer Nakheel and investment company Istithmar World. At DP World, he served as chairman and later combined that post with the chief executive role until 2026.

His current documented office is chairman of the Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation, whose remit covers regulation and oversight across Dubai's ports, customs and free zones. DP World reports that the Government of Dubai is its ultimate owner. These roles establish a long career managing government-owned trade infrastructure, but not that its companies, ports or investments form part of Bin Sulayem's personal fortune.
